claim: Capacity/re-entry/coupling factorial discriminates selective capacity, truth-bound re-entry and corruption-overcoupling effects.
J-space shows intermediate-depth emergence, limited capacity, broadcast-like weight organization and causal role in flexible cognition with explicit architectural limitations.
Bandwidth-limited shared workspace with competition can support specialization/compositionality/synchronization.
Global Latent Workspace can be framed as translation among specialized latent spaces.

At router AUC≈0.921 and pull sensitivity .95, selective push+pull achieved mean relevant coverage .98734 while reducing physical deliveries .67641 and irrelevant deliveries .89766 versus full broadcast.
Useful truthful-reentry delay horizon scaled strongly with process persistence; tested crossover delays 1,2,5,11,29 for rho .60,.80,.90,.95,.98.
Age-of-Information-at-Query formalizes freshness at receiver query/use time for pull-based communication and can yield different policies from indiscriminate push freshness.
